title: The cross-provider journey redo over Stellar/Stripe/Flutterwave/Paystack (the Stellar corridor wave)
source: The operator's standing follow-on order (recorded at P21-0 §0, 2026-10-27): 'when you're done redo the same work with any combination of the following providers' — a Stellar testnet wallet with contract-deployment, the GHS→USDC(Stellar)→KES corridor mandate, over the same Stripe/Flutterwave/Paystack test credentials. Registered beside P23 (which closed 2026-10-29 delivering the repair-discovery machinery this wave builds on — the platform work item platform:cross-provider-route-shape is P22's named deliverable). The honest station fact at registration: the eleventh reset destroyed secrets/payment-providers.env — the live tiers (Paystack/FLW probes, Stripe sandbox, the REAL Stellar testnet operations) are OPERATOR-GATED on key re-supply; the lanes proceed credential-free on the scripted tier (the P23 zero-credential precedent).
policy: Register only. No P22 implementation or acceptance is claimed by the graph. The order's honest scope reading (ADR-0016 D1): the journey law over any provider combination the providers' REAL capabilities ground — where a provider is read-only by its own nature (Flutterwave, ADR-0014 D7) the journey surfaces that honestly (typed exclusions + repair cards), never manufacturing a route; the corridor mandate GHS→USDC(Stellar)→KES is the named deliverable (compile → present → authorize → execute on the tier available). The frozen laws this wave preserves: the nine existing route shapes BYTE-IDENTICAL (the byte-compat gate — every existing shape's compilation over the P23 fixture worlds unchanged); the P21 honest no-route law preserved (without the observed onchain middle, the fiat pair still compiles NOTHING); the P23 hypothesis tier UNCHANGED (hypotheses never compile — the corridor is a new observation-grounded surface, never a hypothesis promotion); Flutterwave READ-ONLY byte-identically (ADR-0014 D7 not amended); PAY-class intents stay max-hops-1 (the corridor rides MOVE/CONVERT); the no-bypass discipline extends over every new surface (the deploy operation, the composite act, the Stellar kernel, the corridor compile — typed refusals at every gate, marker scans, structural falses); key material exclusively inside the seal (the escape-scan law); LIVE-class PSP keys and pubnet Stellar targets refused at the edge (INV-25); web stays honest (the unbound notes); no closure claim may assert a live testnet operation that did not occur (D12). The cross-lane contract is the ADR-0016 appendix (the STELLAR family literals, the stellar:testnet environment, the issuer-scoped asset shape, the deploy operation, the cross-provider-corridor shape + the one new location pair, the Paystack operation ids + grant law, the Stellar seal verb + key shapes, the composite-act digest/idempotency law, the corridor direction classes).

work_orders.lane_scope: Source-backed gap matrix (spec/productization/P22-0-GAP-MATRIX-2026-10-29.md — eight requirement families R1-R8, every EXISTS/LAW/MISSING row verified at 7e19526 by two Explore survey lanes 158-a/158-b) + ADR-0016 (D1 the registration + the honest scope reading; D2 the Stellar plane on the onchain chain (the STELLAR family + stellar:testnet, never a PSP provider); D3 the issuer-scoped asset identity; D4 the contract-deploy vocabulary + lifecycle path + the deployment evidence record; D5 the cross-provider-corridor shape (4 legs) + the ONE new location pair (observed-middle only) + the byte-compat gates; D6 the composite authorization act (one plan-scoped artifact, per-leg commands + per-leg idempotency, the partial-failure custody-continuity law, N=1 byte-pinned); D7 the no-bypass extensions; D8 the Paystack execution lane amendment (Flutterwave stays read-only); D9 the Stellar seal law (the keypair material, the StrKey shapes, the Horizon probe, the network-declared mode gate); D10 the E2E law + the Stellar secret-scan shapes + the live-tier operator gate; D11 the hop-bound law (MOVE/CONVERT, no tenth ask field); D12 the credential gate + the closure policy; D13 the frozen-file amendment scoped to D6 only) + the canonical work orders + this graph + the current-state registration + the baseline batteries re-run at registration (the seven exact-matching the P23 closure record: opportunities 22f/317t, route-planning 23f/260t, lab 19f/176t, route-compiler 29f/353t, payswap-app 56f/592t, surface 19f/234t, desktop 56f+1skipped/463t+1skipped; the P22-relevant additions: onchain-domain 14f/197t, onchain-adapters 15f/135t, onchain-extensions 16f/164t, onchain-security 31f/384t, provider-runtime 25f/302t, capability 18f/230t, financial-certification 16f/134t, merchant 25f/353t — all GREEN; the three scoped desktop tsc gates 0/0/0; architecture:check 0/0/0; the eleventh-reset sibling-dist casualty rebuilt and disclosed).

The Stellar onchain plane (concurrent with P22-C — disjoint packages; the cross-lane contract frozen by the ADR-0016 appendix): the STELLAR family member + the semantics table entry (the lane pins the exact values with the battery) + the family extension (the StrKey G…/S…/C… address shapes; the issuer-scoped asset extension — D3) + the stellar:testnet chain descriptor + the TESTNET environment registry entry (D2) + the onchain.contract_deploy operation kind + its semantics/effects + the deploy lifecycle path (prepare→authorize→broadcast→observeResult→evidence; the deployment evidence record {txHash, contractId, sourceHash, bytecodeHash}; the SmartContractExtensionPin derivation law — only from a REAL deployment record) + the Stellar ChainFamilyAdapter over Horizon (the injected-fetch seam, NO SDK: the observe stage — chain head, account, asset positions with issuer-scoped balances; the write path the corridor needs — the Soroban deploy + the transfer; the classic-asset issuance path as the asset vehicle alternative, both honest on testnet) + the failing-first batteries (the family/semantics laws, the environment fail-closed law re-pinned, the StrKey shape laws, the issuer-collision law (two issuers = two assets), the deploy no-grant typed refusals, the deployment-evidence completeness law, the adapter observe/write laws over a scripted Horizon). Files: packages/onchain-domain/**, packages/onchain-adapters/**, packages/onchain-extensions/**, packages/onchain-security/** ONLY (the security package grows only what the deploy/signer law requires). UNTOUCHED: route-compiler, route-planning, opportunities, financial-certification, merchant, provider-runtime, desktop, payswap-app, surface.

The route vocabulary (concurrent with P22-A — disjoint packages): the cross-provider-corridor route shape (FIAT_PSP_COLLECT → PSP_STABLECOIN_ISSUANCE → ONCHAIN_TRANSFER → OFF_RAMP_PAYOUT, the exact skeleton law) + the ONE new location pair (PROVIDER_ACCOUNT → BANK_INSTRUMENT, admitted ONLY through this shape AND ONLY with an observed ONCHAIN middle — D5) + the byte-compat gates (every existing shape's compilation over the P23 fixture worlds byte-identical; the P21 honest no-route law re-pinned on the unobserved middle) + the corridor chain fixtures (the stellar relay chain — an ONCHAIN rail on stellar:testnet with the issuer-scoped USDC; the GHS on-ramp + KES off-ramp chains) + the ONCHAIN-rail vocabulary growth in opportunities (the rail-key/rail-kind laws over stellar:testnet; the repair/hypothesis vocabulary growth for the corridor's exclusions) + the funding/payout method pins for the corridor (named once, pinned — the ADR appendix discipline) + the leg-separation/custody-continuity laws for the 3-provider 4-leg execution (financial-certification) + the merchant directory data growth (the KES receiving context) + the failing-first batteries. Files: packages/route-compiler/**, packages/route-planning/**, packages/opportunities/**, packages/financial-certification/**, packages/merchant/** ONLY. UNTOUCHED: onchain-*, provider-runtime, desktop, payswap-app, surface, capability, lab.

The host execution plane (after the A/C contracts): the submitStellarSecretKey verb + the keypair material shape + the StrKey shape law + the Horizon verification probe (D9) + the bridge admission growth (the onchain-derived chains — the corridor chain derives from the onchain plane's four-layer hierarchy per ADR-0008 D5, NEVER a PSP probe id; the funding-source/destination folds grown honestly) + the per-provider lane registry (the execution-lane-composition Stripe-hardcode becomes the kernel table — E4) + the Stellar execution kernel + read-back behind ExecutionAuthorityPort (the SANDBOX-only/testnet-only grant law, INV-25) + the Paystack execution lane amendment (D8: the transfer operation ids, the POST-capable transport, createPaystackExecutionKernel + the read-back; sk_test_ → the SANDBOX payout grant; sk_live_ refused at the verb; Flutterwave byte-identically read-only) + the composite dispatch orchestration (D6/D13: the plan-scoped artifact digest covering every leg; the per-leg commands each with its own connectionRef + the (mission, operation, legIndex, intentDigest) idempotency key; the partial-failure custody-continuity law — a later leg NEVER dispatches after an earlier leg's non-CONFIRMED outcome; the N=1 single-leg laws byte-pinned by the existing tests staying green unmodified) + the merchant directory + declared corridor growth + the host structural mirrors (the layer law) + the failing-first batteries (the seal laws, the kernel grant laws, the lane-registry laws, the composite-act refusals — a leg outside the authorized plan is a typed AUTHORIZATION_MISMATCH; the partial-failure laws; the mirror batteries against the real provider-runtime/onchain adapters). Files: packages/desktop/src/host/**, packages/provider-runtime/** (+ packages/provider-node/** if the transport seam requires) ONLY. UNTOUCHED: onchain-*, route-compiler, route-planning, opportunities, financial-certification, merchant, lab, payswap-app, surface, the renderer compositions.

The app + renderer composition (after the host members): the provider mention entries (Paystack + the Stellar onchain rail — the honest labels; the composer router never guesses) + the corridor journey surfaces (the four-leg plan presentation — the leg lanes, the custody chain, the USDC asset with its issuer, the per-leg prerequisites in people language, the leg count disclosed) + the composite-act UI (the plan-scoped two-act approval; the per-leg dispatch surfaces with the per-leg lanes; the partial-failure presentation — a leg UNKNOWN shows the pending-reconciliation card, the P20 plane) + the renderer chains/observations growth (the ONCHAIN rail keys; the wait-recheck observations over the corridor chains) + web keeps the honest unbound notes + the failing-first batteries (the pin-mirror fidelity, the card/plan laws, the session validation, the boot laws — no census drift). Files: packages/payswap-app/**, packages/surface/**, the renderer composition files ONLY. UNTOUCHED: the host shell members' contracts (the composition binds EXISTING members + the P22-H growth), onchain-*, route-*, opportunities, financial-certification, merchant, provider-runtime, lab, capability.

TL integration and closure: the bridge battery (the full corridor journey through the REAL channel with the plan asserted — the honest no-route on the unobserved middle → the observed corridor compiles → the four-leg content → the composite two-act approval → the per-leg dispatch over the scripted transports → the read-backs → the partial-failure laws → the persistence + the deterministic replay) + the no-bypass battery extended over every new surface (ADR-0016 D7 — the deploy refusals, the composite-act leg-scope refusals, the Stellar kernel mode refusals, the corridor compile refusals, the marker scans, the structural falses) + the E2E law (the CDP corridor plan-content journey on the scripted tier + the persistence recheck + the machine-verified secret-free receipt with the Stellar S…-shape scan; the browser tier J-rows registered and covered; the live-tier harness extended and RUN ONLY on key re-supply) + the integrated batteries (all fifteen packages) + the architecture check + the JOURNEY-MAP/FEATURE-MAP reconciliation (the Stellar plane, the corridor shape, the composite act rows; the platform:cross-provider-route-shape work item marked DELIVERED) + the P22 graph closure + the current-state closure + PUSH + the bundle archive + the honest carry-forward record (the live-tier operator gate if the keys have not returned; the P24 candidates unchanged).

closure_policy: P22 closes only when P22-A/C/H/B/D are all accepted on main with their batteries green at the tip AND the corridor is proven end-to-end on the tier available: the GHS→USDC(Stellar)→KES intent compiles the four-leg plan with every leg observation-grounded (or the honest no-route + repair cards when the middle is unobserved), the composite two-act approval authorizes the WHOLE plan (the digest covers every leg; a leg outside the plan is a typed refusal), the per-leg dispatch executes on the scripted tier (or the live tier when the operator has re-supplied the keys), the read-backs are authoritative, the partial-failure laws hold, the persistence re-derives the plan deterministically, and the no-bypass battery proves that no deploy, no composite act, no Stellar kernel and no corridor compile can bypass the deterministic planner, the security policy or the financial authorization gates. A documentation-only or test-count-only wave cannot close P22. THE LIVE STELLAR TESTNET TIER IS A NAMED GATE: if the keys are re-supplied before closure the live tier lands inside it; if not, the closure records the live tier as the STANDING OPERATOR ACTION — an explicit, disclosed carry-forward in the acceptance record's verdict, never a silent pass. The P24 candidate list (the live-model binding, the consent plane, the CLI-agent skill/MCP, the automatic evidence feeds) stays unregistered — P22's closure does not open P24.
